title: KEEN-town Action Grant supports ALAASKA-3C portability
body: Suman Saha received a $1,000 award from the Kern Family Foundation through the KEEN-town Action Grant Program for “From Prototype to Practice: Making ALAASKA-3C Portable for the KEEN Community.” Saha serves as principal investigator. The award supports the project from August 2026 through June 2027.
